questions.question: Eight people are sitting in two parallel rows containing 4 people each in such a way that there is equal distance between adjacent persons.In row 1 – B, A, C and K are seated and all of them are facing south.In row 2 – I, D, E and L are seated and all of them are facing north.Thus each person faces another person from the other row.A sits third to the right of C. The one facing L is an immediate neighbour of C. The one facing B is an immediate neighbour of L. The one facing A is an immediate neighbour of D. I sits at some place to the left of E. In this question, a statement is given followed by two courses of action, numbered I and II. You must assume everything in the statement to be true, and on the basis of the information given in the statement, decide which of the given courses of action logically follow(s) for pursuing.Statement:Many ocean animals die daily due to the staggering amounts of hazardous chemicals and plastic pollution in our water bodies.Courses of action:I. The government and all responsible organisations should ensure that no plastic waste or harmful substances are dumped into water bodies. The rules regarding waste disposal should be implemented and enforced by the government with immediate effect.II. Campaigns are held by various organisations to educate the public about dangers caused to the ocean animals due to dumping of hazardous waste in water bodies.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Both I and II follow.) है।
